name: TUN_OP_KAD_SEARCH
format: legacy demo search (exit reads local cache) -- superseded by V2

name: TUN_OP_BULK_SUBSCRIBE
format: V->exit start bulk push for a stream

name: TUN_OP_BULK_NACK
format: V->exit re-push missing (seq, block): stream_key 16 + count 1 + (seq 4 + block_idx 1)*count

name: TUN_OP_DVR_FETCH
format: V->exit: <StreamKey 16><FromSeq 4><Count 1>; response via bulk plane 0xD9 with BulkDataHeader.flags bit0=FLAG_DVR (flag not linter-governed; see PROTOCOL_REGISTRY.md prose). NOT in code yet.

name: TUN_OP_DVR_NACK
format: exit->V: same reason codes as OP_LIVE_DVR_NACK 0xB8. NOT in code yet.

name: TUN_OP_DVR_OFFER
format: exit->V: DVR ranges reachable via the exit. NOT in code yet.

name: TUN_OP_CHANNEL_FETCH
format: V->exit: fetch channel manifest/record by pubkey; single-cell band 0x24-0x3F (below 0x40 multi-cell threshold). NOT in code yet.

name: TUN_OP_CHANNEL_DATA
format: exit->V: channel manifest/record bytes (large sealed manifests may instead ride the bulk plane). NOT in code yet.

name: TUN_OP_KAD6_GATEWAY
format: V<->exit Kad6 gateway service; reassembled body = exact K6FrameV1. Runtime dispatches K6-1 search, K6-3 source/publish and K6-4 target-ticket/DIAL/stream/PEX-hints/VEP families; unsupported messages fail closed. Multi-cell (>=0x40), signed-cap gated, legacy 0x42/0x43 preserved.
